create_playwright_context: create a PlaywrightContextManager to initialize a synchronous Playwright browser session with context management
enter_playwright_context: enter the PlaywrightContextManager context to get a SyncPlaywright instance for browser automation
start_playwright_session: start a Playwright session using the start method to return a SyncPlaywright instance
exit_playwright_context: exit the PlaywrightContextManager to stop the connection and clean up the event loop
test_playwright_context_manager: test the PlaywrightContextManager class for proper context entry, exit, and resource cleanup
